job.job_description:
Position: FSD
Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly skilled FSD in engineering delivering applications developed using Python Angular.

Required skills:

Python, FastAPI, Micro Services, Micro Frontend, Angular2 Above Microsoft Visual Studio Code, PostgreSQL, Design Patterns, GitLab, Jenkins, JSON.

Roles and responsibility:
Thorough knowledge in implementation of Python, FastAPI and Angular 2+ above.
Experienced in Java script, HTML5, CSS 3.0.
Good SQL knowledge using Postgresql.
Should have good understanding of Design Patterns and usage of AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Github Copilot.
Experience in modernization/migrations of enterprise applications to the cloud (AWS)
Good GitLab, Agile, JIRA, SDLC, Swagger, Postman.
Design, develop, integrate, evaluate, and provide support during implementation.
Should have sound debugging skill to identify the root cause for any kind of production defect and should be able to provide a workaround.
Need to understand database concepts and write efficient queries.
Ability to perform technical analysis, design identify impacts.
Should have experience in working under an Agile methodology.
Effective communication skills. Educational Qualification:
B.E/B.Tech.



Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
